lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Перенос подложек из прежнего Debug
value.surface: Хранилище подложек: этап, время и отмена
value.meaning: Phase/time describe the current source attempt; bytes/tiles received do not mean the whole migration is finished.
value.value_origin: Pinned Debug URI -> TransferSession phase/bytes/tiles/monotonic elapsed -> current uncanceled control -> localized LegacyUnderlayProgressText -> bounded status ScrollView; Cancel has its own fixed row.
value.units: Received bytes, received tile count, source ordinal/count and floor(monotonic elapsed milliseconds/1000) seconds for this attempt.
updates: Opening is visible before the worker/first byte. Receiving starts on read; final record enters Finalizing; validated published asset enters Attaching.
Watchdog pulses progress/lease through local finalization; a remote inactivity deadline applies only before stream completion/attach. One existing retry remains.
Only the same active uncanceled control can update text; phase changes scroll to the start.
actions: Cancel closes/interrupts owned IO; queued cancel immediately restores UI/releases its lease.
Back requires the existing exit confirmation while a transfer is active.
conditions: Selected project and UNDERLAY_MIGRATION ownership remain stable until actual IO exits.
List/another import are hidden while transferring; Cancel remains outside scrollable content.
value.saved_state: In-process progress is not a durable completion ACK; validated catalog/provenance and atomic asset publication retain the existing restart/deduplication contract. Source Debug originals and IPC trust/schema stay unchanged.
expectations: Oracle: slow open shows Opening and elapsed pulses; completed stream with local work shows Finalizing even when bytes no longer change.
Cancel before worker start releases the exact owned lease; late/canceled control cannot replace the current status.
Complete Russian status can scroll at280/320dp and font1/1.3/2 in both orientations/themes; Cancel remains fully visible and actionable.
unknowns: Reported ten-minute delay cause and real old-Debug throughput remain UNKNOWN; new session/native tests are compile-only.
Uncooperative old Binder provider may outlive cancellation; late PFD is rejected, but this change does not promise a killable cross-package Binder call.
Real whole-window/OEM/nonlinear-font/touch and large-transfer/attach performance require tomorrow’s authorized live run.
